Torchlight 2. A game that aimed to improve on Diablo 2? no way in hell. But it did.
By the way, Serious Sam was originally supposed to be 3 times as long.
Terraria deserves a mention here. That game was more bang for your buck ($15, and all the expansions were free) than any other game I've played.

Witcher 3. Everything about that game is epic. It went above and beyond what it set out to be.
